confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live booking pages or current listings. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately reliable. Accommodation anchors are less certain and assume July green-season rates with Thai VAT and service charges included. FX provenance is weaker than the price anchors: I did not open an rba.gov.au page. The 0.6955 value for 2026-10-15 comes from search summaries attributing it to the RBA table, and a third-party page gives 0.6947 for 2026-10-16. Confirm against the RBA F11.1 table before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional Southeast Asian capital basis, calibrated to Bangkok's tourist districts (Khao San, Sukhumvit, Silom). Beer and cocktail prices use the usual Thai restaurant-to-bar price relationship where direct knowledge is thin.
